title: A1
query: What is the functional domain associated with EGFR protein?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(d:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN d.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A2
query: What are the amino acid changes and mutation descriptions for EGFR protein?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) WHERE ANY(label IN labels(m) WHERE label IN [   'Missense', 'OtherMutation', 'CodingSilent', 'Nonsense', 'DeletionFrameshift',   'InsertionInframe', 'DeletionInframe', 'InsertionFrameshift',   'ComplexDeletionInframe', 'ComplexFrameshift', 'CompoundSubstitution', 'ComplexInsertionInframe' ]) RETURN    CASE      WHEN 'Missense' IN labels(m) THEN m.hasWildTypeResidue + toString(m.hasStartLocation) + m.hasPKAResidue     WHEN 'OtherMutation' IN labels(m) THEN m.hasMutationAA     ELSE NULL   END AS AminoAcidChange,   m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN (m.hasWildTypeResidue + toString(m.hasStartLocation) + m.hasPKAResidue) AS amino_acid_change,        m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description UNION ALL MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(om:OtherMutation) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN om.hasMutationAA AS amino_acid_change,        om.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName:'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN coalesce(m.hasMutationAA, m.hasWildTypeResidue + '->' + m.hasPKAResidue) AS amino_acid_change, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description LIMIT 100

title: C7
query: Find pathways that include proteins containing the functional domain 'PI3_PI4_kinase' and have mutations. Please provide the names of these pathways and descriptions of the mutations.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathwayName, collect(distinct COALESCE(m.hasMutationDescription, head(labels(m)))) AS mutationDescriptions LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mut) WHERE mut.hasMutationDescription IS NOT NULL RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName, mut.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'})<-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]-(protein:Protein) MATCH (protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) MATCH (protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mutation) RETURN DISTINCT pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathway_name,        COALESCE(mutation.hasMutationDescription, 'Mutation: ' + head(labels(mutation))) AS mutation_description LIMIT 100
